decision_table.because: Dark section divider provides a high-impact start; slide 1 is a similar alternative.
Content slide with navigator allows for a list of topics with a progress indicator.
Standard section divider for thematic shifts; slide 5 and 7 are alternatives.
Designed for a single centered title or short identifier.
Standard content slide with a headline and a single body slot for bullets.
Two-column comparison with examples; slide 6 is an alternative for analysis matrices.
Three-phase process flow is the standard roadmap; slide 3, 10, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 21 offer specific variations.
Project Timeline and Costing is the only slide specifically for financial/effort metrics.
Phased Data Comparison is the only layout that explicitly supports a data chart.
Minimalist centered text slot is best for high-impact quotes.
Project Organization Chart is designed for team roles and governance.
Dark section divider provides a clean, definitive end to the deck.

variety_rule: Interleave standard bullet slides (8) with visual process flows (13, 18), analysis matrices (6, 12), and high-impact dividers (1, 7) to break the monotony of text.
